title: Cubes Reimagined
description: How to Make Minecraft Feel Brand New Again is a YouTube video by Dimaxxed in which he goes into detail about the mods he uses to make playing Minecraft fun.
body:
# Cubes Reimagined

Cubes Reimagined is a lightweight client-side Fabric modpack inspired by Dimaxxed's "How to Make Minecraft Feel Brand New Again" video. It combines visual enhancements, immersive animations, quality-of-life improvements, and performance optimizations into a single package that makes Minecraft feel more modern without straying far from the vanilla experience.

Rather than adding new progression systems, dimensions, or major gameplay overhauls, Cubes Reimagined focuses on refining the game you already know and love.

## Features

### Enhanced Visuals

* Improved lighting, shadows, and rendering through modern optimization and graphics mods
* Better particles, environmental effects, and visual polish throughout the game
* Enhanced sky, weather, and atmospheric effects for a more immersive world
* Improved block, item, and entity rendering for a cleaner overall presentation

### Better Animations & Immersion

* More natural player animations and movement
* Improved first-person interactions and item handling
* Enhanced camera movement and visual feedback
* Smoother entity and gameplay animations that make the world feel more alive

### Quality of Life Improvements

* Better inventory management and interface enhancements
* Improved tooltips and information displays
* More convenient navigation and gameplay utilities
* Small usability improvements that reduce frustration without changing vanilla mechanics

### Audio & Atmosphere

* Enhanced ambient sounds and environmental audio
* More immersive world ambience while exploring, mining, and adventuring
* Improved overall soundscape that helps make each biome feel distinct

### Performance Optimizations

* Sodium and other modern optimization mods for significantly improved FPS
* Reduced stuttering and smoother chunk loading
* Better memory and rendering performance
* Lightweight client-side improvements designed to keep the game running smoothly

### Multiplayer Friendly

* Primarily client-side, allowing use on most vanilla and modded servers
* Improves your gameplay experience without requiring servers to install the pack
* Maintains compatibility with standard Minecraft gameplay
